category: OOS_1: Pre-existing flaky tests in test_plot_cost_over_time.py and test_report_tokens_render.py
body:
**Description**: 4 tests fail intermittently in the full suite but pass in isolation. They have no dependency on any CI-module function changed in this PR. This is a pre-existing test ordering/environment issue.
**Reason not implemented**: Out of scope for this PR; unrelated to keyword-only enforcement.
